overview.description: The Defiance AI Capacitors Leaders ETF (CAPA) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the BITA AI Capacitors & MLCC index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of publicly listed equities involved in capacitors and passive electronic components used to support artificial intelligence infrastructure. CAPA was launched on Aug 25, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
